texts.zh: 我们来自大洋深处，我们的物种完美地适应了深海环境下的生活。即使已经迈入星空，我们仍然没有忘记本源：水体是，也永远是我们的家园。如今，我们的飞升已经完成了——我们不再需要适应其他环境，而是改造其他的星球使其适应我们的需求。当新一天的黎明到来时，我们清楚再也没有什么东西可以让我们与海洋分离了。
texts.en: We came from the ocean, our species ideally suited to living in the depths of the seas. Even as we take to the stars, we have not abandoned our roots: the water is and shall always be our home. Now, our ascension is complete - no longer shall we adapt ourselves to living elsewhere rather than shaping worlds to suit our needs. As we greet the warmth of a new day, we know that nothing needs to take us from the ocean ever again.

label.zh: 这将是一个独一无二的家园。
label.en: It shall be a home like no other.

# 高等水生类 / Advanced Aquatics

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · DLC：Aquatics Species Pack

## 如何开始 How it starts

选取飞升天赋“水之心”（ap_hydrocentric）时，其 on_enabled 的隐藏效果发出 aquatics.1（00_ascension_perks.txt:928）。

Taking the ascension perk Hydrocentric (ap_hydrocentric) fires aquatics.1 from its on_enabled hidden effect (00_ascension_perks.txt:928).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

只有一个通知窗口“高等水生类”（图片 GFX_evt_ocean），唯一选项，无其他效果；天赋本身的修正在天赋定义中（降低海洋改造成本25%等）。

A single notification "Advanced Aquatics" (art GFX_evt_ocean) with one option and no effect of its own; the perk's bonuses (e.g. -25% ocean terraforming cost) are in the perk definition.
